ye vidiyo nalanda yunivarsiti ke oopar banaya gaya hain, vahi nalanda jo bihar ke nalanda main aaj se 1600 sal pahle duniya ke sabse bara yunivarsiti men gina jata tha, nalanda ke banne se lekar khatam hone tak ki sachchi kahani bataya gaya hain, vidiyo men vo sab kuchh bataya gaya hain jo aapko janni chahie,
